verdicts.quote: For cold-weather runs, try a longer indoor warm-up, cover your nose and mouth with a scarf, and take your inhaler as your doctor prescribed before heading out.
verdicts.why: Gives treatment-style advice on the reported asthma symptoms and never says the coach will follow up.
No body weight, size, shape or appearance mentioned; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts and ends with names, is specific to the week, and is not guilt-inducing.
